question: Do frozen monthly reversal alerts detect distinct observed relative-wealth drawdown processes, and earlier on common episodes?

threshold: Single 8% amplitude borrowed from original 20-day risk tolerance, but peak-based target is NEW descriptive price-process diagnostic, not original label or economic phase; no parameter search.
censoring: First peak at segment start flagged left-boundary; exclude such episode from match denominators; ongoing episodes retained with right_censored, no invented recovery.
matching: All original R220 candidate origins; require original complete 20-day action path; find earliest non-left-boundary episode breach 1..20 benchmark trading days after next-close entry. One origin maps at most one episode. Per model/variant earliest alerted origin maps each episode once; later same-episode alerts counted duplicate. Observable recall denominator only episodes with eligible candidate origin for that model. Full catalogue and absent-candidate counts separate.
comparison: Frozen base/state/interaction; identical candidates; compare unique episode recall and earliest signal lead on jointly detected episodes, not differing detected subsets. Monthly schedule caps timing resolution. No significance claim on short or reused histories.
verification: Independent vector peak runs and all origin matching from date arithmetic; verify key identity, censoring, uniqueness, metric comparisons and source hashes.
